videos.script: Leave a model at temperature zero long enough, and it may start to repeat itself. {{repeat}} The same sentence. The same list item. Round and round. {{round}} Each step takes the likeliest word, and sometimes the likeliest words lead back to where they began. {{circle}} Two controls push against that. Both lower the score of words the output has already used. {{lower}} The frequency penalty charges more with every repeat. The presence penalty charges once, for having appeared at all. {{two}} In this lesson you watch toylm write the cat sleeps, over and over, and see exactly why. {{loop}} You break the circle with each penalty, and find a setting where only one of them works. {{break}} Then you push a penalty too far, and watch it mangle a sentence that needed its own words. {{far}}
